name: Link File Browser
description: Adds a file-explorer button to the link field widget for picking files from a configured folder. SECURITY: its ajax/list-files endpoint (permission 'view link file browser') builds a scandir path from CLIENT-controlled 'directory'/'root' params with no ../ sanitization, so a permitted user can traverse and enumerate arbitrary server directories (info disclosure). Confine to public:// with realpath()+str_starts_with.
